description: This file declares the JavaScriptFunction class within the WPEFramework::JavaScript namespace. The class provides an interface for creating JavaScript functions, including a method to build a JS static function and retrieve its name. It manages internal state such as the function's name, callback, and enumeration behavior.

classes.name: JavaScriptFunction
classes.description: Represents a JavaScript function in the WPEWebKit environment, allowing construction of static functions and retrieval of function names.

methods.name: BuildJSStaticFunction
methods.description: Creates and returns a JS static function representation suitable for registration in a JavaScript environment.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the name of the JavaScript function.
